content.shortDescription: Calcula la cuota mensual fija y el coste total en intereses de un préstamo personal o de libre disposición.
content.shortDescription_en: Calculate monthly installment payment and total interest costs for a personal loan.
content.longDescription: Estima la cuota mensual fija requerida para devolver un préstamo personal no garantizado según el capital prestado, tasa de interés anual (TIN %) y plazo de amortización en meses.
content.longDescription_en: Estimate fixed monthly installment payment required to pay off an unsecured personal loan based on principal, annual interest rate, and term length.
howToUse: Ingresa el monto del préstamo personal solicitado.
Establece la tasa de interés anual (%).
Indica el plazo en meses (ej. 12, 36, 60 meses).
Consulta la cuota fija mensual y el total de intereses acumulados.
howToUse_en: Enter requested personal loan principal amount and active currency.
Enter loan repayment term in months (e.g. 12, 36, 60 months).
View fixed monthly payment and total accumulated interest.
content.methodology: Fórmula Préstamo Personal: Cuota = Capital × [ (r / 12) / (1 - (1 + r / 12)^-n) ].
content.methodology_en: Personal Loan Formula: Payment = Principal × [ (r / 12) / (1 - (1 + r / 12)^-n) ].

guideSections.title: Fixed Rates vs Variable Personal Loans
guideSections.content_html_en: Fixed-rate personal loans lock in your monthly payment for the entire term, protecting you from interest rate increases during repayment.
guideSections.content_html: Los préstamos personales a tasa fija mantienen una cuota mensual idéntica durante todo el contrato, ofreciendo estabilidad presupuestaria.
